AddMember.description: `POST …/members`: make a user a direct member.

binary.description:
NUL bytes or not UTF-8: no `content` (download it through the raw
route).

content.description: The text, at most 1 MiB; `null` when `binary`.

size.description: The whole file's size in bytes.

type.description: `blob` or `symlink` (the content is the link's target).

ChangeProtectedRef.description:
`PATCH …/protected-refs/{rule_id}` (the pattern is fixed: delete the
rule and create another).

path.description:
The path segment (ADR-0015 rules; a top-level name must not be
reserved).

namespace_id.description:
The parent: a personal or a group namespace (`namespace_id` of a
user, of `GET /api/v1/groups/{id}` or of the resolver).

pattern.description:
`refs/heads/…` or `refs/tags/…`, ≤ 255 bytes, at most one `*` and
only in the last part (ADR-0008); unique in the project ignoring case.

DeletionBody.description:
`DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id}`: when the grace period began and when
the purge may start.

purge_after.description:
UTC, RFC 3339: the project is restorable until then (and until its
purge has started).

mode.description: The octal mode as git prints it (`100644`, `040000`, …).

path.description: The entry's full path in the tree.

size.description: Bytes; `null` for a tree or a submodule.

GroupBody.description: A group as the API shows it.

parent_id.description: The parent group; `null` at the top level.

role.description: The caller's effective role (`guest` … `owner`); `null` without one.

has_more.description:
More rows may follow (a page can be short, even empty, when its
scan budget ended first).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

KindName.description: A repository kind in a request (ADR-0004; fixed at creation).

ListedGroup.description: A group as a list shows it.

role.description: The caller's effective role (`guest` … `owner`); `null` without one.

MemberBody.description: One direct member as the API shows it.

active.description: `false` while the account is disabled (it holds no role meanwhile).

created_at.description: When the membership was created (UTC, RFC 3339).

role.description: The direct role (`guest` … `owner`); inherited roles are not listed.

MemberPage.description: One page of direct members, in user id order.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

MoveBody.description: A move as it was written.

id.description: The moved project, group or user.

reclaimed_tombstones.description: Tombstones of this very subtree released by `reclaim`.

tombstones.description:
The `moved` tombstones written: one per namespace of the subtree, at
its old path. Each keeps that path blocked until released; a clone
or fetch through it is redirected (`302`) to the new path for
callers who may read the project, a push through it is refused.

ProjectBody.description: A project as the API shows it.

role.description:
The caller's effective role (`guest` … `owner`); `null` without one
(an administrator, or a reader of an internal project).

has_more.description:
More rows may follow (a page can be short, even empty, when its
scan budget ended first).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

ProtectedRefBody.description: One protected ref rule as the API shows it.

push_min_role.description:
The minimum role that may push (create / fast-forward) a matching
ref; force-push and deletion are refused for everyone.

ProtectedRefRules.description: Every rule of a project, in id order.

commit.description: The commit it peels to; `null` for a tag of a tree or a blob.

target.description: The object the ref names (an annotated tag: the tag object).

default_branch.description: The branch HEAD names; `null` for an empty repository.

truncated.description: More refs than the server lists (5 000): the list stops there.

path.description: The path that can be used again.

reclaim.description: Take back an old username of this very user.

username.description:
The new username, which is also the personal namespace's path
(ADR-0015 rules; not a reserved word).

Resolution.description:
Which namespace a path names. Exactly one of `project_id`, `group_id`,
`user_id` is present, by `kind`.

canonical_path.description: The namespace's current path (a moved path: the target's).

ResolveBody.description: A spec split into a revision and a path.

path.description: The rest of the spec: a path in the tree (`""` for the root).

name.description: The short ref name, or the commit id.

type.description: `branch`, `tag` or `commit` (a full commit id was given).

absolute_expires_at.description: When the session ends at the latest (RFC 3339, UTC).

csrf_token.description:
Send as `X-GitStation-CSRF` on every state-changing request (64
lowercase hex; derived from the cookie, the same for the session's
lifetime).

idle_expires_at.description: When the session ends without activity (RFC 3339, UTC).

public_id.description: The session's public id (never the secret).

SessionUser.description: The signed-in user, as the session shows it.

is_admin.description:
The account's administrator flag (a session carries administrator
rights when it is set).

namespace_id.description:
The new parent group's `namespace_id`. Omitted: the current parent
(a rename; a top-level group stays at the top level).

path.description: The new last segment. Omitted: the current one.

reclaim.description: As for a project: take back an old path of this group's subtree.

top_level.description:
`true`: move to the top level (administrators only); not together
with `namespace_id`.

namespace_id.description:
The new parent: a group or a personal namespace (`namespace_id` of
`GET /api/v1/groups/{id}`, of a user, or of the resolver). Omitted:
the current parent (a rename).

path.description: The new last segment (ADR-0015 rules). Omitted: the current one.

reclaim.description:
Take back an old path of this very project (A → B → A): release, in
the same change, the `moved` tombstone there that names it. Default
`false` (a tombstone always blocks until released).

entries.description: In git's order (byte order of the names).

path.description: The tree's path (`""` for the root).

truncated.description: More entries than the server lists (5 000).

UserSelf.description: The caller's account as the API shows it.

is_agent.description: The credential is a token issued for an AI agent.

token_scopes.description: The token's scopes; `null` for a session.

VisibilityName.description: A project's visibility in a request.
